dev.field_note.1: Frost on the inside of the glass.
dev.field_note.2: Nobody has been in here for a long time.
dev.hint.1: Use doors and buttons with the use key.
dev.radio_check.1: Ines, this is Odile. Do you read me?
dev.radio_check.2: I read you. The ice is quiet.
dev.radio_check.3: The survey plane stopped reporting forty minutes ago. What can you see?
dev.radio_check.4: White. Wind. A hull outline, low on the ice, then gone.
dev.radio_check.5: Keep the wind behind you. I am reading the 1971 log. It begins with the weather.
hint_find_shelter: You are freezing. Find shelter or a heater.
tagline: A ship stretched across fifty-nine years.
title: Harmonic
ch1.wreck.1: Ines. The plane stopped reporting. Can you hear me?
ch1.wreck.2: I hear you. Power is gone. The cabin is on its side.
ch1.wreck.4: Bruised. The pilot is not here. I am going to find the hatch.
ch1.hatch.1: The hatch is bent in its frame.
ch1.hatch.2: There is a pry bar in the survey kit.
ch1.outside.2: You will lose heat fast out there. Do not stand still.
ch1.outside.3: The Trust set marker poles from the landing strip. Follow them to the survey hut.
ch1.hut.2: Good. Stay until you are warm.
ch1.hut.3: Past the hut the ice is open. There is a pressure ridge across your line.
ch1.hut.4: I will find a way over it.
ch1.cache.1: Crates. Meridian stencil on every one.
ch1.cache.2: A supply cache. They are further out than we were told.
ch1.cache.3: Pistol rounds. No pistol. I will take them anyway.
ch1.ridge.1: Odile. There is something on the ice.
ch1.ridge.3: A hull. Bow, funnel, mast. Longer than the strip.
ch1.ridge.4: It is thin, like frost on a window. It is flickering.
ch1.ridge.5: That is the Saint Ilse. The logs say it comes twice a day.
ch1.ridge.7: Meridian built their post under it. Their fence is a few hundred metres east.
ch1.fence.1: Floodlights. A gate. Two sentries, none moving.
ch1.fence.2: Stay out of the light, Ines. I will read you the first log.
ch1.fence.3: Stillwater trials, day one: the weather held, and the engine was quiet.
ch1.hint.prybar: Equip the pry bar and strike the hatch.
ch1.hint.ridge: Climb the ridge where the ice has buckled.
hint_ch1_wreck: Out of the wind. Take what you need.
hint_ch1_hut: Warm. Rest until the cold meter is full.
hint_ch1_cache: Meridian stores. Warm enough to rest.
